proposal.rationale: Credential-stuffing campaigns produce many borderline events. Make escalate_malicious dominate block_malicious so the policy routes attacks to Tier-2 LLM triage (with step-up auth) rather than hard-blocking, which both stops the attack AND captures behavioral signal for the Auth/IAM specialist.

metadata.expected_effect: Detection rate on attack class up; escalation rate up (more LLM tier-2 cost while campaign is active); FP rate roughly stable.
